summary: Targeted bug-fix verification for onboarding Skip/Next → /auth transition. All 6 review items PASSED. Skip click writes localStorage.berber_onboarded='1' and navigates to /auth immediately; no bounce-back over 3s wait. 3x Next also lands and stays on /auth. Reload after onboarded lands directly on /auth. Fresh localStorage still shows /onboarding with 3 slides/dots. Admin login works; /app/{about,contact,help} render; Settings has link-about, link-contact, link-help, link-share-app.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is well-scoped: OnboardingGate/AuthGate/CatchAllRedirect wrappers read isOnboarded() inline every render, resolving the stale-cache infinite loop from previous Root() implementation. Verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding→Auth routing bug is fully fixed via inline localStorage read in route guards. Splash screen takes ~2s; wait 2.5s after any hard navigation. Auth inputs use data-testid=auth-phone-input, auth-password-input; login submit is a button[type=submit] inside Auth component.
